district.name: Yadgir
district.description: Cradled between Krishna and Bheema rivers, Yadgir boasts the monolithic triangular Hill Fort, the heroic history of Shorapur Nayakas, Bonal Bird Sanctuary, and prehistoric megalithic stone alignments at Vibhutihalli.
district.descriptionKannada: ಕೃಷ್ಣಾ ಮತ್ತು ಭೀಮಾ ನದಿಗಳ ನಡುವಿರುವ ಯಾದಗಿರಿ, ಏಕಶಿಲಾ ಗಿರಿ ದುರ್ಗ, ಶೋರಾಪುರ ನಾಯಕರ ಶೌರ್ಯದ ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ಬೋನಾಳ ಪಕ್ಷಿಧಾಮ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಭೂತಿಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಶಿಲಾಯುಗದ ಖಗೋಳ ಶಿಲಾ ಸಾಲುಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.

destinations.name: Yadgir Hill Fort
destinations.description: A dramatic triangular medieval fort perched on a 300-meter monolithic granite hillock with 9 stone gates, natural rock pools, Bahmani canons, and panoramic views of Yadgir town and the surrounding plains.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Built by the Western Chalukyas, reinforced by the Yadavas of Devagiri (after whom Yadgir is named), and later fortified by the Bahmanis and Adil Shahis.
destinations.culturalImportance: Local lore identifies it with historic battles between Vijayanagara and Bahmani rulers; houses an ancient Ramasamudra tank.
destinations.roadAccessibility: Paved road up to fort base, stone staircase ascent
destinations.safetyInstructions: Wear non-skid sports shoes; granite steps can get warm by noon. Carry water bottles.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Open entry, managed by Town Municipal Council & Heritage Dept

hiddenGemClassification.reason: Imposing monolithic fortress with commanding 360-degree Deccan views, rarely frequented.

destinations.name: Bonal Bird Sanctuary, Shorapur
destinations.description: Sprawling across a historic 1,200-acre reservoir built by the 17th-century Shorapur Nayakas, this is Karnataka's second-largest wetland bird sanctuary after Ranganathittu, hosting over 10,000 migratory waterfowl including bar-headed geese, flamingos, and pelicans.
destinations.historicalSignificance: The reservoir was constructed by Nayaka rulers of Shorapur in the 17th century; British political agent Philip Meadows Taylor described its beauty in his memoirs.
destinations.culturalImportance: Key migratory roost on the Central Asian Flyway; vital community wetland supporting sustainable local fishing and agriculture.
destinations.bestSeason: November to February (Peak migratory bird season)
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 10 km from Shorapur, 60 km from Yadgir
destinations.roadAccessibility: State Highway 36 to Shorapur, then paved rural road to Bonal
destinations.safetyInstructions: Carry binoculars and telephoto lenses. Do not make loud noise or discard plastic near the wetlands.

hiddenGemClassification.reason: Second largest bird sanctuary in Karnataka, virtually untouched by mainstream commercial tourism.

destinations.name: Shorapur (Surpur) Fort & Meadows Taylor's Bungalow
destinations.nameKannada: ಶೋರಾಪುರ ಕೋಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಿಡೋಸ್ ಟೇಲರ್ ಬಂಗಲೆ
destinations.description: Historic hill redoubt of the brave Bedar Nayakas who fought the British in the 1857 Rebellion under Raja Venkatappa Nayaka. Overlooking the town is the historic 1840s octagonal bungalow built by British administrator and novelist Colonel Philip Meadows Taylor.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Shorapur was a fiercely autonomous Bedar principality; Meadows Taylor served here as political resident and wrote his celebrated classic 'Confessions of a Thug' and 'The Story of My Life'.
destinations.culturalImportance: Sacred center for Bedar/Valmiki community heritage and epic battlefields of 1858.

photos.caption: Shorapur (Surpur) Fort & Meadows Taylor's Bungalow
photos.source: Karnataka State Gazetteer & Shorapur Heritage Society

destinations.roadAccessibility: Paved state highway from Yadgir to Shorapur
destinations.safetyInstructions: Bungalow perched on hill summit; road winds uphill, drive cautiously.
destinations.tourismInformationSource: Karnataka State Gazetteer & Shorapur Heritage Society

destinations.name: Vibhutihalli Megalithic Stone Alignments
destinations.description: A globally significant prehistoric archeo-astronomical observatory comprising hundreds of huge granite boulders arranged in precise diagonal and grid alignments dating back to 1000 BCE, used by ancient stargazers to track equinoxes and solstices.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Researched by international archaeo-astronomers; proves sophisticated celestial knowledge and calendar calculations in Iron Age Karnataka.
destinations.culturalImportance: Prehistoric megalithic heritage showing continuous human civilization in the Krishna-Bheema Doab for over 3,000 years.

photos.caption: Vibhutihalli Megalithic Stone Alignments
photos.source: Archaeological Survey of India & Archaeo-astronomy Survey

destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 5 km from Shahapur, 35 km from Yadgir
destinations.roadAccessibility: Paved road connecting Shahapur and Vibhutihalli village
destinations.safetyInstructions: Do not disturb or move ancient upright stones. Avoid midday heat.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Protected by Archaeological Survey of India
destinations.tourismInformationSource: Archaeological Survey of India & Archaeo-astronomy Survey
